storage: Airtight container at room temperature, away from damp and sunlight; refrigerate in humid weather to keep weevils away.
looksLike: Small yellow split lentils, larger and rounder than toor dal, with one flat side.
howToPick: Bright, even yellow splits with no insect holes, dust or musty smell. Polished and unpolished (slightly duller) both cook well; unpolished is a pricier niche.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months if kept dry (general guidance; not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 3 g per serving (about ½ tsp, in the tempering)
